title: Japan seeing UAP over the last five years
summary: Dylan Borland tells of Japan seeing UAP over the last five years, about about 2021-2026 at Japan (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Japan's popping off almost as if Japan's seeing stuff recently in the last 5 years or so.

plain: Dylan Borland, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says Japan seems to have been seeing a lot of UAP, unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs, over the last five years or so. In his words, Japan is "popping off." If true, it would mean the sightings are not only an American matter.
